class Solution:
    def backspaceCompare(self, s: str, t: str) -> bool:
        i, j = len(s) - 1, len(t) - 1
        skip_s, skip_t = 0, 0
        while i >= 0 or j >= 0:
            while i >= 0:
                if s[i] == '#': skip_s += 1; i -= 1
                elif skip_s > 0: skip_s -= 1; i -= 1
                else: break
            while j >= 0:
                if t[j] == '#': skip_t += 1; j -= 1
                elif skip_t > 0: skip_t -= 1; j -= 1
                else: break
            if i >= 0 and j >= 0 and s[i] != t[j]: return False
            if (i >= 0) != (j >= 0): return False
            i -= 1; j -= 1
        return True
